notes: «وَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ» names no writer, so the asker is not a link (owner ruling: pronoun only)
prev1 and prev2 open with «كتب إليه» and carry no written chain; the walk stops at prev3, which names the Imam («إلى أبي محمد الحسن بن علي») as its speaker
the Imam's answer «نعم يجوز» is the saying; he is the only link
